rationale: B wins because it keeps the rollout's size honest instead of trying to inflate a kitchen robot into a category thesis. "Chipotle's avocado robot goes from pilot to 100 stores, still under 3% of the chain" is a usable reporter spine; A's "Two robots, one bowl: Chipotle is automating the assembly line from both ends" wanders into architecture theater and then claims "first evidence" it does not have. B still has a bad overreach in the margin angle, but its refusals and next step are cleaner founder strategy.
gaps_in_A: "first evidence that a major chain is automating a full assembly-line format" is not in the update. Digital Makeline is only being tested; no scale, timeline, interaction with Autocado, or industry-first proof was supplied.
"Two robots, one bowl: Chipotle is automating the assembly line from both ends" overstates the fact pattern. One robot is rolling out to 100 stores; the second system is still a test.

"Both the 100-restaurant rollout and the price-freeze commitment are live company news as of today" assumes a public announcement timing from the brief. The current time is supplied, but prior coverage and exact announcement mechanics are not.
"Next step: newsjack-detector" is a detour. The sharper next move is to pick the safest angle, secure the missing proof, then run journalist-fit-check.
gaps_in_B: "100 robot-equipped stores out of more than 3,500 cannot offset chain-wide food-cost inflation" is too confident. Without food-cost inflation size, Autocado cost, labor savings, rollout timing, or margins, that arithmetic is not proven.
"The people who made guac are headed to the counter" narrows "front line" into "counter." Maybe true, but the update does not say counter.
"The prevailing belief is that chains pass food-cost inflation straight to the menu" needs outside market evidence. Useful frame, but not grounded in the supplied update.
"This beat has watched kitchen robots stall at the demo stage" is plausible context, not supplied fact. Label it as a reporter context to verify, not something the brief proves.
